Does the cheaper one have the same warranty as the pricier one?

Yes — if both are Simple Modern products bought from us or another authorized seller in the U.S. or Canada, the warranty is generally the same regardless of whether one costs more. 🙂

Our Limited Lifetime Warranty covers manufacturer defects, like:

lids that won’t thread correctly or leak when they’re supposed to be leakproof
insulation failure
certain issues with stitching, zippers, clips, or handles on bags
warped or non-functioning plastic/silicone parts
shipping damage if reported before use

It doesn’t cover normal wear and tear, drops, misuse, or modifications.

So price alone usually isn’t what changes the warranty — features and style do, not the coverage. Let me know if there’s anything else I can help with!
